top_signals.title: US Treasuries Rally as AI Selloff Sends Investors to Havens
top_signals.summary: US Treasuries soared as mounting doubts over the artificial intelligence trade sent stocks tumbling and investors flocking to haven assets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: ETFs: High Conviction Through Novel Strategies
top_signals.summary: Inkoo Kang, Executive Director of Tactical Products at ProShares, Ryan Lee, SVP of Product & Strategy at Direxion ETFs, and Corgi's Chief Investment Strategist Jeff Weniger join Bloomberg Intelligence's Athanasios Psarofagis at the Bloomberg ETFs in Depth conference in New York on November 19, 2026. The panel examines the rise of increasingly novel ETFs, from leveraged products to private-market and synthetic exposures, and where the limits of the ETF wrapper may lie. They also discuss investor sophistication, the challenge of turning new products into commercial successes and why education becomes increasingly important as strategies grow more complex. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
